items.title: Lumentum beats estimates on AI demand, guides above consensus
items.summary: Investing.com -- Lumentum Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:LITE) reported fiscal fourth quarter adjusted earnings per share of $3.23, beating the analyst estimate of $2.95 by $0.28. Revenue reached $1.01 billion, surpassing the consensus estimate of $984.57 million and marking a 109% increase from $480.7 million in the same quarter last year.
